It combines high output and torque with a transmission and driveline designed to manage both on-road driving and aggressive off-road use. Factory (model) features — detailed description - Powertrain and transmission - 3.5L EcoBoost twin-turbo V6 rated at 450 hp and 510 lb-ft of torque. The engine is tuned to deliver broad, usable torque for acceleration, towing and off-road drivability. - 10-speed automatic transmission calibrated to take advantage of the EcoBoost powerband and provide smooth shifts under load and during performance driving. - Drivetrain and off-road systems - Four-wheel-drive capability with an off-road oriented transfer case and traction control logic that supports high-speed desert runs and technical low-speed terrain. - Terrain Management System with multiple selectable drive modes that adjust throttle mapping, transmission shift logic, traction control and stability systems for conditions such as Normal, Sport, Weather, Mud/Sand and Baja (mode availability varies by model year/package). - Electronic aids such as traction control, trailer sway control and hill descent control to help manage traction on varied surfaces. - Chassis, suspension and braking - Long-travel, off-road tuned suspension using Fox racing dampers with internal bypass technology and remote reservoirs (Raptor-specific hardware) to control wheel motion through large bumps and at high speeds. - Wider track and reinforced suspension mounting points compared with standard F-150 models to improve stability and ground clearance during aggressive driving. - Heavy-duty brake components sized and calibrated for the truck’s weight and performance duties. - Body, structure and underbody protection - High-strength, lightweight aluminum alloy body panels over a high-strength steel frame to reduce overall vehicle weight while maintaining structural rigidity. - Raptor-specific front fascia, grille and wider fenders for improved approach angles and wheel travel. - Factory skid plates and reinforced lower structure elements to protect the engine and driveline during off-road use. - Exterior features - Distinctive Raptor styling: unique grille treatment, more aggressive bumpers and pronounced flares to accommodate the larger track and tires. - Integrated tow hooks and available factory lighting provisions for added utility. - Wheels and tires - Raptor models are engineered for larger, aggressive all-terrain tires and wheel sizes that support beadlock-capable wheel designs and enable high-speed off-road operation. - Interior and convenience (model features commonly included) - A driver-focused cockpit with performance-oriented instrumentation and steering wheel controls for drive mode selection and vehicle system information. - Durable interior materials selected to withstand outdoor and work use, available upgrades include leather and Alcantara trim, heated seating and additional comfort features depending on trim and packages. - SYNC infotainment platform with available touchscreen, Bluetooth, smartphone integration (Apple CarPlay/Android Auto on equipped vehicles), and available navigation. - Safety and driver assistance - Comprehensive airbag system and occupant protection features consistent with contemporary F-150 safety packages. - Factory provisions for optional driver assistance systems such as blind-spot monitoring, cross-traffic alert and 360-degree camera systems.
